question: Write a postcard from a lighthouse keeper.
base_frame:
Q: Write a postcard from a lighthouse keeper.
A:

steered.text:
The paper is already too dark. It used to be the color of the inside of my mouth, but now it is just a hollow thing. I don't know if I can't feel my heart anymore, or if the darkness has taken everything else.

I used to scream for help, but now even I won't make the silence I feared so much. I can't find the right words, so I won't bother writing them
